professionalSummary.text: Candidate has three years of experience as an Implementation Consultant at an HR software company, configuring payroll and absence products for twenty-three mid-sized employers under the configuration standard.
professionalSummary.witness: Implementation consultant at an HR software company for three years, configuring the payroll and absence products for twenty-three mid-sized employers under the configuration standard.

experienceHighlights.text: Candidate ran policy workshops for each implementation under the workshop method, resolving customer team disagreements into recorded decisions with customer sign-off.
experienceHighlights.witness: Ran the policy workshops for each implementation under the workshop method; the workshop records show the policy decisions captured, including the disagreements within customer teams resolved into a recorded decision, with the customers' sign-off on each workshop record.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Candidate loaded and reconciled customer employee data with the data migration team, with reconciliation reports signed by the customer's HR lead.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Loaded and reconciled each customer's employee data with the data migration team, with the reconciliation report signed by the customer's HR lead.

skills.text: Candidate trained customers' HR administrators under a training plan, with go-live approval remaining with the implementation manager and recorded on the go-live checklist.
skills.witness: Trained the customers' HR administrators under the training plan; go-live approval was the implementation manager's, recorded on the go-live checklist together with which checks were mine.

optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The materials establish the candidate's experience in configuring HR software, running workshops, loading data, training HR administrators, and documenting limitations. They do not establish the candidate's ability to work with customer HR teams who disagree, or the specific details of the implementation tool references.

decisionBoundary.statement: The materials provide sufficient evidence to support the candidate's qualifications for the role, but further human review is required to confirm the candidate's ability to work with customer HR teams who disagree and to verify the implementation tool references.
